create_beit_backbone: create a BEiT backbone model with monkey-patched forward methods for arbitrary window size support
build_pretrained_beit_large_512: build a pretrained BEiT-Large 512x512 backbone model for MiDaS depth estimation
build_pretrained_beit_large_384: build a pretrained BEiT-Large 384x384 backbone model for MiDaS depth estimation
build_pretrained_beit_base_384: build a pretrained BEiT-Base 384x384 backbone model for MiDaS depth estimation
run_beit_forward: run the BEiT model forward pass on input tensor x using forward_features method
